requirements.title: The item's task fork and change on the hub
requirements.rationale: Every item works in a fork of its own and reaches the workspace only as one change, which nightshift opens because a session's token cannot.

criteria.condition: a part of nightshift calls the change service's `EnsureFork(ctx, item)` for an item that has no fork stored, while the hub is available to the worker token
criteria.action: send `POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace}/forks` with the worker token and the body `{"name": "i<N>", "auto_change": false, "purpose": "nightshift item <N>: <title>"}` (the purpose cut to 1,024 characters), store for the item the fork's slug, its git URL (the answer's `remote`), the branch name `item-<N>` and the generation 1, and append to the item's thread an entry of kind `fork_created` with the text `task fork <slug> created`, not marking the thread unread
criteria.contract: returns `Record{Item, Workspace, Fork: "<workspace>--i<N>", GitURL, Branch: "item-<N>", Generation: 1, Change: 0}`; the request carries no `ttl`, `token` or `session_id`; a second call returns the stored record and sends no request; when the hub answers `409 conflict`, the fork `<workspace>--i<N>` is read with `GET /api/v1/workspaces/<workspace>--i<N>` and stored as the item's, with its `hub_url` as the git URL; `Get(ctx, item)` returns the same record, and `change.ErrNotFound` for an item with no fork

Second case, the fake hub already holds demo--i9 and answers the POST 409 conflict: rec = svc.EnsureFork(ctx, 9); assert rec.Fork == 'demo--i9' and one GET of that workspace was sent

criteria.condition: a part of nightshift calls `Forget(ctx, item)` for an item with a stored fork, and `EnsureFork` is called for the item afterwards
criteria.action: remove the item's stored fork and change while keeping its generation, send nothing to the hub for the forgetting, and create at that `EnsureFork` a fork named `i<N>-<g>`, g being one above the kept generation, storing it as the item's with no change
criteria.contract: after `Forget`, `Get` returns `change.ErrNotFound`; the next `EnsureFork` returns a record with `Fork: "<workspace>--i<N>-2"`, `Generation: 2`, `Branch: "item-<N>"` and `Change: 0`; `Forget` for an item with no fork returns nil

criteria.action: request `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{fork}/scm/refs/item-<N>` with the worker token and return the commit the branch points at
criteria.contract: returns the ref object's `sha`; `change.ErrNoBranch` when the hub answers `404 ref_not_found`; `change.ErrNotFound` for an item with no fork, with no request sent

criteria.condition: a part of nightshift calls `OpenDraft(ctx, item, title, intent, sessionID)` for an item whose fork holds the branch `item-<N>` and that has no change stored

criteria.action: return the error, store nothing and write no thread entry
criteria.contract: `change.ErrHubUnavailable`, with no request sent, while the hub is not available; otherwise the hub client's typed error with the hub's status and `error_type`; the item's stored record is as it was before the call; an error of the abandon hook does not keep the item from being `abandoned` (package 03 writes it to the thread as `abandon_hook_failed`)

requirements.title: When planning starts, and under which package number
requirements.rationale: A person who typed a defect expects it planned without another command, a part split off by an agent waits until the person wants it, and two planners in one workspace must never write the same package number.

criteria.condition: the scheduler calls the step this package registers for the state `new` for an item of kind `spec`
criteria.action: move the item to `ready` through the item service's `Transition` with the reason `imported package`, creating no fork and asking for no session
criteria.contract: the item is `ready`; the hub saw no request for it

criteria.condition: the scheduler calls the step of the state `new` for an item of kind `defect` or `change_request` whose source type is not `item`, or for which `item plan` was run
criteria.action: move the item to `planning` through `Transition` with the reason `planning started`
criteria.contract: the item is `planning`, so that the step of `planning` is called for it at the scheduler's next pass

criteria.action: leave the item in `new`: no transition, no fork, no package number, no session and no hub request

criteria.contract: status 200 with the item object of package 03; a second request for the item while it is `new` is 200 too; a `no_plan_approval` once stored as true stays true when a later request leaves it out; `plan.Service.NeedsApproval(ctx, item)` is false when the item's `plan_approval` is false or `no_plan_approval` was stored as true, and true otherwise

requirements.title: The planner run and its result
requirements.rationale: The implementer works from the package alone, so a plan counts only when the package the hub holds is the one asked for and validates.

criteria.condition: the scheduler calls the step this package registers for the state `planning` for an item that has no accepted package, and the item's branch on the fork holds no package with the item's number
criteria.action: ensure the item's fork with `change.EnsureFork`, give the item its package number, and ask the scheduler with `RunSession` for a session with the role `planner`, the step name `plan`, the fork, the branch `item-<N>`, the input `text` holding the item's text, the prompt `/af-spec {input:text} --unattended --number <NN> --no-activate --result {result}`, with ` --defect` appended for an item of kind `defect`, and the acceptance function of this requirement
criteria.contract: the `session.Spec` holds exactly those values and no `Commit`, and the request no class; the input `text` is the text the item was created with, and for an item imported from an issue `# <title>`, a blank line, the body, and for each comment in order a blank line, `## Comment by <author>`, a blank line and the comment's body

the fake scheduler returns `interrupted` for the session, so that the step stops after asking

B

## Comment by ann

c1

## Comment by bob

criteria.condition: a planner session ended with a result file whose `outcome` is `written`, the fork holds the branch `item-<N>`, the directory under `.specs/` at the branch's head whose numeric prefix equals the item's number loads with `afspec.LoadSpec`, and `afspec.ValidateInRoot` reports no error for it
criteria.action: accept the result and, when `RunSession` returns the session as `completed`, record the package's directory and the branch's head as the item's accepted package, append to the item's thread an entry of kind `plan_written` with the text `package <NN_name> written`, and go on to the review of the plan
criteria.contract: the acceptance function returns nil; warnings of the validation do not refuse; the prefix is compared as a number, so `7` matches `07_x`; the package is read from a clone of the fork that nightshift brings to the head with `gitclone.Sync` at `<clones directory>/<fork slug>.plan`, never from the session's clone; `plan.Service.Get(ctx, item)` reports the number, the directory, the head and the phase `review`

criteria.condition: a planner session ended with a result file whose `outcome` is missing or is not `written`, or the fork has no branch `item-<N>`, or the branch's head holds no package directory with the item's number, or that package does not load, or its validation reports an error
criteria.action: refuse the result, so that the session counts as failed, and keep nothing of it
criteria.contract: the acceptance function returns an error whose first line is `planner: result has no outcome`, `planner: <outcome>: <reason>` (`planner: <outcome>` when the result has no reason), `branch item-<N> is not on the fork`, `no package <NN> on the branch`, `package <NN> does not load: <error>` or `package <NN> does not validate: <check>: <message>` with the first error; no kept text, no draft change and no linked item is made, and the plan stays at the phase it was at

criteria.contract: the step returns nil for a result that is not `completed` and for `sched.ErrNotStarted`, and the context's error for a cancelled context; the next call of the step asks for the same session again, with the same prompt and inputs; no thread entry of this package, no change and no kept text is written for that session
